title: RdfOntologyReasoningStatus
description: Which projected ontology graphs production reasoning takes, across every glossary. Production reasoning uses Approved axioms and Approved terms only, so a fresh deployment, whose axioms start in Draft, may include none.

included.description: Approved axiom and term graphs, and every relationship-type graph a closure may use.

excluded.description: Axiom and term graphs left out, by reason.

activeOntologies.description: Glossaries with an active Approved version manifest.
